title: Western Ghats Monsoon Ghat Road Advisory
description: Intermittent monsoon showers along Charmadi and Shiradi ghat sections. Commuters and travellers are advised to maintain safe vehicle speeds and check local police route clearance before travelling after dusk.
issuingAuthority: Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC)

title: ASI Monument Conservation Sunset Regulations
description: Per Archaeological Survey of India regulations, ticketed monument compounds strictly close at 18:00 (sunset) daily for archaeological preservation. Night entry into fenced monument zones is strictly prohibited.
issuingAuthority: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Hampi Mini Circle

title: Mysuru Palace Festival Traffic & Illumination Information
description: Regular Sunday palace illumination takes place from 19:00 to 20:00. Designated parking is available at the Dasara Exhibition Grounds. Pre-booking online parking pass is recommended during weekends.
